Strategy: Reward bins whose residual sits within ten of the mean feasible residual, targeting the middle of the current distribution, while keeping the mid penalty. This adapts the sweet band to each state instead of fixed limits, but the mean may sit in an awkward range and the band may rarely trigger.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if abs(r - sum(bins) / len(bins)) <= 10 else 0) - (20 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
